purpose: spec §20: the acceptance semantics did not change for Generation 2, so AcceptanceProfileV2 continues in force (no V3) and this binding attaches it to the Generation-2 protocol

generation.truth_bundle_version: truth-manifest:v2 (TruthManifestV1 schema, evaluator-bound; truth/public separation enforced)

unchanged_requirements.population_rule: each holdout case family must reach >= 2/3 repetitions at BenchmarkCaseOutcomeV2 in {success, success_with_limitations}; ALL families must meet the floor
unchanged_requirements.six_axes: structural (zero tolerance), functional (truth floor), semantic, negative-case safety, reliability (plan/integrate <= 0.2, specialist <= 0.5), availability (provider-terminal <= 0.2)
unchanged_requirements.verdict_rule: ACCEPTED only if ALL six axes PASS; otherwise REJECTED; B6_INVALID / BENCHMARK_PREFLIGHT_BLOCKED are not acceptance measurements
unchanged_requirements.independence_declaration: these requirements are inherited from the product contract and threshold provenance — they are NOT adjusted in response to the Generation-1 B6 diagnostic (0/3 and 1/3), which is DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY and formally B6_INVALID

generation2_protocol_additions: every Agent-visible holdout input presealed and hash-bound before admission (PublicHoldoutCaseV2 + HoldoutSealV2)
charter authored only at generation construction time; B6 preflight loads/validates/hash-checks/bootstraps and never authors semantics
coverage-to-question associations declared in the sealed public contract and projected verbatim
negative_flags resolved to evaluator-only truth metadata; negative_risk_context is the only Agent-visible framing slot
seal mismatch or post-seal mutation blocks execution (enforce_execution_gate)

calibration_continuity.reason: production runtime, model configuration and calibration corpus are unchanged; Generation-1 B6 invalidity does not invalidate the calibration baseline
